# {.tabset}

## Overview

**Purpose**: score the 67 malignant metaprograms of the Weizmann Curated Cancer Cell Atlas (3CA) in the melanocytic
lineage (melanoma cells and non-malignant melanocytes) and compare them across disease category (non-malignant,
primary, metastasis), intra-ocular location of primary tumours and treatment of metastases.

**Input**: the full atlas object (`../new_data_2026b/Objects/full Dataset/`), cells with `majority_celltype`
"Melanoma cells" or "Melanocytes". UCell scores (default settings) are computed once and cached in
`../Outputs/Metaprograms_3CA_2026b/`; UMAP coordinates are those of the atlas.

**Unit and tests**: the patient. Each point is one tumour or tissue (`orig.ident`, at least 10 cells); tests use the
mean score per patient (`Patient_nr`), two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum, groups with fewer than 3 patients are drawn but
not tested. P-values are Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted over the comparisons of one panel (3 per program; 9 for
MP22-MP24) and shown as adj. p, stars from adj. p. Ciliochoroidal tumours (1 patient) are not shown.

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table); library(ggplot2); library(ggsignif); library(ggbeeswarm); library(scattermore)
  library(ComplexHeatmap); library(circlize); library(patchwork)
})
source("colors_2026b.R")
fig_dir <- "figures"; tab_dir <- "tables"
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE); dir.create(tab_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
out_dir <- "../Outputs/Metaprograms_3CA_2026b"
ORIGINS <- c("non-malignant", "primary", "metastasis")
LOCS <- c("choroid", "iris", "ciliary body")
MIN_CELLS <- 10              # cells per orig.ident for a point
UMAP_Q <- c(0.01, 0.99)      # colour cap of the score UMAPs
```

```{r ucell-scores}
f_scores <- file.path(out_dir, "ucell_3CA_scores_per_cell.qs2")
f_umap <- "../Outputs/CytoTRACE2_2026b/atlas_umap.csv.gz"
if (!file.exists(f_scores) || !file.exists(f_umap)) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(Seurat))
  obj <- qs2::qs_read("../new_data_2026b/Objects/full Dataset/final_Subtyping_iCNV_reclustered.qs2", nthreads = 1)
  if (!file.exists(f_umap)) {
    e <- Embeddings(obj, "umap")
    fwrite(data.table(cell = rownames(e), UMAP_1 = e[, 1], UMAP_2 = e[, 2]), f_umap)
  }
  if (!file.exists(f_scores)) {
    mp_df <- readxl::read_excel("../Weizman_3CA_meta_programs_2025-01-29.xlsx", sheet = "Malignant")
    sets <- lapply(mp_df, function(g) unique(g[!is.na(g)]))
    names(sets) <- stringr::str_squish(names(sets))   # "MP38  NPC (glioma)" has a double space
    stopifnot(length(sets) == 67)
    keep <- colnames(obj)[obj$majority_celltype %in% c("Melanoma cells", "Melanocytes")]
    meta <- obj@meta.data[keep, c("orig.ident", "Sample", "Patient_nr", "origin", "majority_celltype", "Malignant",
                                  "primary_mutation", "secondary_mutation", "organ", "primary_location",
                                  "healthy_location", "metastatic_location", "TreatmentStage_ofProcessedSample")]
    obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(obj[["RNA"]])
    cnt <- LayerData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")[, keep]
    # UCell ranks genes within each cell, so counts and log-normalised data give the same score
    sc <- UCell::ScoreSignatures_UCell(cnt, features = sets, name = "", ncores = 16)[keep, names(sets)]
    dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    qs2::qs_save(data.table(cell = keep, meta, sc, check.names = FALSE), f_scores, nthreads = 1)
  }
  rm(obj); invisible(gc())
}
uc <- qs2::qs_read(f_scores, nthreads = 1)
mps <- grep("^MP[0-9]+ ", names(uc), value = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(mps) == 67, all(uc$majority_celltype %in% c("Melanoma cells", "Melanocytes")))
umap <- fread(f_umap)
```

The score table holds `r format(nrow(uc), big.mark = ",")` melanocytic cells
(`r format(sum(uc$majority_celltype == "Melanoma cells"), big.mark = ",")` melanoma cells,
`r format(sum(uc$majority_celltype == "Melanocytes"), big.mark = ",")` melanocytes) from
`r uniqueN(uc$orig.ident)` tumours/tissues of `r uniqueN(uc$Patient_nr)` patients.

```{r helpers}
nfmt <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ",")
mp_of <- function(s) { m <- grep(paste0("^", s, " "), mps, value = TRUE); stopifnot(length(m) == 1); m }
wrap_cap <- function(x, width_in) paste(strwrap(x, floor(13 * width_in)), collapse = "\n")
adj_label <- function(padj) sprintf("%s  adj. p %s",
  as.character(cut(padj, c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf), c("***", "**", "*", "ns"))),
  ifelse(padj < 2.2e-16, "< 2.2e-16", paste("=", trimws(formatC(padj, digits = 2, format = "g")))))
thm <- theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8.5),
        plot.caption.position = "plot", plot.title.position = "plot")
save_gg <- function(p, id, w, h) {
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(id, ".pdf")), p, width = w, height = h, device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(id, ".png")), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
}
show_png <- function(ids) knitr::include_graphics(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(ids, ".png")))
cells_txt <- sprintf("%s melanocytic cells (%s melanoma cells, %s melanocytes)", nfmt(nrow(uc)),
                     nfmt(uc[majority_celltype == "Melanoma cells", .N]), nfmt(uc[majority_celltype == "Melanocytes", .N]))

# x: one row per cell with orig.ident, Patient_nr, the grouping column and the score v.
# pts = one point per orig.ident (>= MIN_CELLS cells); pat = patient means, the unit of the test.
units <- function(x, grp) {
  pts <- x[, .(score = mean(v), n_cells = .N), by = c("orig.ident", "Patient_nr", grp)]
  stopifnot("an orig.ident sits in two groups" = !anyDuplicated(pts$orig.ident))
  pts <- pts[n_cells >= MIN_CELLS]
  list(pts = pts, pat = x[orig.ident %in% pts$orig.ident, .(score = mean(v), n_cells = .N), by = c("Patient_nr", grp)])
}
pat_tests <- function(u, grp, levels, panel, what) {   # all pairs of groups with >= 3 patients
  n_by <- table(factor(u$pat[[grp]], levels = levels)); lv <- names(n_by)[n_by >= 3]
  if (length(lv) < 2) return(data.table())
  rbindlist(lapply(combn(lv, 2, simplify = FALSE), function(pr) {
    a <- u$pat[get(grp) == pr[1], score]; b <- u$pat[get(grp) == pr[2], score]
    data.table(panel = panel, score = what, group1 = pr[1], group2 = pr[2], n_patients1 = length(a),
               n_patients2 = length(b), median1 = median(a), median2 = median(b),
               p = suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(a, b)$p.value))
  }))
}
with_bh <- function(tt) { if (nrow(tt)) tt[, p_adj_BH := p.adjust(p, "BH")]; tt }
box_panel <- function(u, grp, levels, tests, title, fill = NULL, note = NULL, width = 6.5, ylab = "Mean UCell score") {
  pts <- u$pts[get(grp) %in% levels]; pat <- u$pat[get(grp) %in% levels]
  levels <- levels[levels %in% pts[[grp]]]
  stopifnot(nrow(pts) > 0)
  pts[, x := factor(get(grp), levels = levels)]
  n_pt <- table(pts$x); n_pa <- table(factor(pat[[grp]], levels = levels)); small <- names(n_pa)[n_pa < 3]
  xlab <- setNames(sprintf("%s\nn = %d (%d pat.)", levels, as.integer(n_pt), as.integer(n_pa)), levels)
  tt <- if (nrow(tests)) tests[group1 %in% levels & group2 %in% levels] else tests
  cap <- paste(c(sprintf("Points = tumour/tissue (orig.ident, >= %d cells). n = orig.ident (patients).", MIN_CELLS),
                 if (nrow(tt)) sprintf("Wilcoxon on patient means, two-sided, BH-adjusted within the panel (%d tests).", nrow(tt)),
                 if (length(small)) sprintf("Not tested (< 3 patients): %s.", paste(small, collapse = ", ")), note),
               collapse = " ")
  p <- ggplot(pts, aes(x, score)) +
    (if (is.null(fill)) geom_boxplot(fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6)
     else geom_boxplot(aes(fill = x), alpha = 0.45, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE)) +
    geom_quasirandom(width = 0.22, alpha = 0.85, colour = "black", size = 2.2) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = xlab) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.06 + 0.11 * nrow(tt)))) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = ylab, caption = wrap_cap(cap, width)) + thm
  if (!is.null(fill)) p <- p + scale_fill_manual(values = fill)
  if (nrow(tt)) p <- p + geom_signif(comparisons = unname(Map(c, tt$group1, tt$group2)),
                                     annotations = adj_label(tt$p_adj_BH), step_increase = 0.11,
                                     tip_length = 0.01, textsize = 3.2, vjust = -0.2)
  p
}

# Score UMAP: cells drawn in order of score, highest on top (random order among ties).
umm <- merge(umap, uc[, c("cell", mps), with = FALSE], by = "cell")
stopifnot("UMAP misses melanocytic cells" = nrow(umm) == nrow(uc))
set.seed(14); umm <- umm[sample(.N)]
umap_panel <- function(m, id) {
  lim <- quantile(umm[[m]], UMAP_Q); if (diff(lim) <= 0) lim <- range(umm[[m]])
  p <- ggplot(umm[order(umm[[m]])], aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, colour = .data[[m]])) +
    geom_scattermore(pointsize = 2.8, pixels = c(2400, 2400)) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "magma", limits = lim, oob = scales::squish, name = "UCell") +
    labs(title = m, x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2",
         caption = wrap_cap(sprintf("Atlas UMAP, %s. Highest score on top; colour capped at percentiles %g and %g (%.3f-%.3f).",
                                    cells_txt, 100 * UMAP_Q[1], 100 * UMAP_Q[2], lim[1], lim[2]), 7.5)) +
    thm + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
  save_gg(p, id, 7.5, 7)
}
# One program: UMAP + patient-level boxplot by disease category; returns the tests.
program_panels <- function(s, umap_id, box_id) {
  m <- mp_of(s)
  umap_panel(m, umap_id)
  u <- units(uc[, .(orig.ident, Patient_nr, origin, v = get(m))], "origin")
  tt <- with_bh(pat_tests(u, "origin", ORIGINS, box_id, m))
  save_gg(box_panel(u, "origin", ORIGINS, tt, m, fill = origin_colors,
                    note = "Melanoma cells of tumours, melanocytes of non-malignant tissue."), box_id, 6.5, 6.5)
  tt
}
tests <- list()
```

## Fig. 3a / Suppl. Fig. 6a

Correlation (Pearson, cell level) of the 30 programs with the highest mean UCell score, and the top 20 programs.

```{r fig3a-sfig6a, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 9}
mp_mean <- sort(colMeans(uc[, ..mps]), decreasing = TRUE)
top30 <- names(mp_mean)[1:30]
cm <- cor(as.matrix(uc[, ..top30]))
dimnames(cm) <- list(sub(" .*", "", top30), sub(" .*", "", top30))
# Heatmap built inside each device: a stored Heatmap object can crash a later ggsave
make_ht <- function() Heatmap(cm, name = "Pearson r", col = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("blue", "white", "red")),
                              row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9), column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
                              column_title = sprintf("Top 30 metaprograms by mean UCell, cell-level correlation\n(%s melanocytic cells)", nfmt(nrow(uc))),
                              column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"))
png(file.path(fig_dir, "Fig3a_mp_top30_correlation.png"), width = 8.5, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)
draw(make_ht(), padding = unit(c(3, 3, 3, 12), "mm")); invisible(dev.off())
cairo_pdf(file.path(fig_dir, "Fig3a_mp_top30_correlation.pdf"), width = 8.5, height = 8)
draw(make_ht(), padding = unit(c(3, 3, 3, 12), "mm")); invisible(dev.off())

b <- data.table(MP = names(mp_mean)[1:20], mean = unname(mp_mean[1:20]))
p <- ggplot(b, aes(mean, reorder(MP, mean))) + geom_col(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", mean)), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(title = "Top 20 metaprograms by mean UCell score", x = "Mean UCell score", y = NULL,
       caption = wrap_cap(sprintf("All %s; cell-level mean.", cells_txt), 8)) + thm
save_gg(p, "SFig6a_mp_top20_mean_ucell", 8, 7)
show_png(c("Fig3a_mp_top30_correlation", "SFig6a_mp_top20_mean_ucell"))
```

## Fig. 3l-m Interferon/MHC-II

Dot plots with Seurat `DotPlot` semantics on the UCell scores (colour: per-program z-score of the group average,
clipped at +-2.5; size: % cells with a score > 0), and the same programs as patient-level boxplots.
Treatment groups of the metastases have 1-3 patients each, so that comparison is descriptive.

```{r fig3lm}
ifn <- vapply(c("MP22", "MP23", "MP24"), mp_of, character(1))
dot_panel <- function(x, grp, levels, labels, id, w, h) {
  long <- melt(x[, c(grp, ifn), with = FALSE], id.vars = grp, variable.name = "MP", value.name = "s")
  dd <- long[, .(avg = mean(expm1(s)), pct = 100 * mean(s > 0)), by = c(grp, "MP")]
  dd[, z := pmin(pmax(as.numeric(scale(log1p(avg))), -2.5), 2.5), by = MP]
  dd[, g := factor(get(grp), levels = levels)][, MP := factor(MP, levels = ifn)]
  stopifnot(!anyNA(dd$g))
  p <- ggplot(dd, aes(g, MP, colour = z, size = pct)) + geom_point() +
    scale_colour_gradient(low = "lightgrey", high = "blue", name = "Average Expression") +
    scale_radius(range = c(1, 6), name = "Percent Expressed") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = labels) + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + thm +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  save_gg(p, id, w, h)
}
ifn_boxes <- function(x, grp, levels, test, fill, id, title, cap, w, h, flip = FALSE) {
  us <- lapply(ifn, function(m) units(x[, .(orig.ident, Patient_nr, g = get(grp), v = get(m))], "g"))
  tt <- if (test) with_bh(rbindlist(Map(function(u, m) pat_tests(u, "g", levels, id, m), us, ifn))) else data.table()
  ps <- lapply(seq_along(ifn), function(i) {
    ti <- if (test) tt[score == ifn[i]] else data.table()
    p <- box_panel(us[[i]], "g", if (flip) rev(levels) else levels, ti, ifn[i], fill = fill) + labs(caption = NULL)
    if (flip) p <- p + coord_flip() + if (i > 1) theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
    p
  })
  save_gg(wrap_plots(ps, nrow = 1) + plot_annotation(title = title, caption = wrap_cap(cap, w), theme = thm), id, w, h)
  tt
}

dot_panel(uc, "origin", ORIGINS, setNames(ORIGINS, ORIGINS), "Fig3l_dotplot_MP22_24_origin", 6.5, 4.5)
tests$Fig3l <- ifn_boxes(uc, "origin", ORIGINS, TRUE, origin_colors, "Fig3l_box_MP22_24_origin",
                         "Interferon/MHC-II programs by disease category",
                         sprintf("Points = tumour/tissue (orig.ident, >= %d cells); %s. Wilcoxon on patient means, two-sided, BH-adjusted within the panel (9 tests: 3 programs x 3 comparisons). n = orig.ident (patients).",
                                 MIN_CELLS, cells_txt), 14.5, 6.5)

met <- uc[origin == "metastasis"]
tr_lv <- sort(unique(met$TreatmentStage_ofProcessedSample))
dot_panel(met, "TreatmentStage_ofProcessedSample", tr_lv, setNames(sub(" \\(", "\n(", tr_lv), tr_lv),
          "Fig3m_dotplot_MP22_24_treatment", 8, 5)
n_tr <- met[, .(n_pat = uniqueN(Patient_nr), n_cells = .N), by = TreatmentStage_ofProcessedSample][order(-n_pat, -n_cells)]
ifn_boxes(met, "TreatmentStage_ofProcessedSample", n_tr$TreatmentStage_ofProcessedSample, FALSE, NULL,
          "Fig3m_box_MP22_24_treatment", "Interferon/MHC-II programs by treatment, metastases",
          sprintf("Points = tumour/tissue (orig.ident). %s melanoma cells of %d metastases (%d patients). n = orig.ident (patients). %d-%d patients per arm: descriptive, no test.",
                  nfmt(nrow(met)), uniqueN(met$orig.ident), uniqueN(met$Patient_nr), min(n_tr$n_pat), max(n_tr$n_pat)),
          14, 5.5, flip = TRUE)
show_png(c("Fig3l_dotplot_MP22_24_origin", "Fig3l_box_MP22_24_origin",
       "Fig3m_dotplot_MP22_24_treatment", "Fig3m_box_MP22_24_treatment"))
```

## Suppl. Fig. 6b

MP45 in malignant cells of primary tumours by intra-ocular location.

```{r sfig6b}
m45 <- mp_of("MP45")
u6 <- units(uc[Malignant == "Malignant" & origin == "primary", .(orig.ident, Patient_nr, primary_location, v = get(m45))],
            "primary_location")
tests$SFig6b <- with_bh(pat_tests(u6, "primary_location", LOCS, "SFig6b_box_MP45_pUM_location", m45))
save_gg(box_panel(u6, "primary_location", LOCS, tests$SFig6b, paste(m45, "in primary UM"), fill = primary_location_colors,
                  ylab = "Mean UCell score, malignant cells", note = "Ciliochoroidal (1 patient) not shown.", width = 7),
        "SFig6b_box_MP45_pUM_location", 7, 6.5)
show_png("SFig6b_box_MP45_pUM_location")
```

```{r write-tests, include=FALSE}
fwrite(rbindlist(tests), file.path(tab_dir, "tests_metaprograms.csv"))
```
